full.sacrifices: Original optimized renderer, with existing captured-store limitations.

no-wiring.sacrifices: No event, keyboard, hatch or machine wiring. Captured tab-state can conceal missing initialization and effects.

no-validation.sacrifices: No markup safety validation. Never use with unvalidated input.

clone-templates.sacrifices: Caches parsed markup across documents without proving ownership semantics, invalidation or memory bounds.

no-attributes.sacrifices: Skips row attribute binding, breaking links, controls and accessibility attributes.

no-charts.sacrifices: Omits custom renderer output, including charts.

lean.sacrifices: Combines no-wiring, clone-templates and no-validation; single-fixture HTML parity does not prove semantic correctness.

minimal.sacrifices: Lean plus missing attributes and charts; still stamps rows, binds text and serializes DOM.

no-serialization.sacrifices: Builds the full DOM but sends only an assembly-only marker; excludes HTML serialization and payload transfer.

serialize-only.sacrifices: Serializes a frozen document; no data queries, binding or chart generation. A serialization control, not a renderer.

static.sacrifices: Returns captured HTML unchanged; no rendering or freshness. A response-serving control.
